source_review.finding: The timed supplied-edge path still invoked torch.unique over edge pairs and batch IDs, so strict O(E_local + N) model-forward execution was not established.

failed_contracts: GraphBatch did not carry a validated-edge assertion
collation did not reject duplicate edges
collation did not reject missing self edges
prediction did not forward the assertion

implementation: GraphBatch collation now checks range, uniqueness and one self edge per node before setting edge_index_is_validated.
Direct EquivariantAttention and EGNN calls remain fully validated by default.
The trusted model path performs tensor metadata checks only and does not invoke torch.unique.
Graph metadata now checks contiguous IDs with max plus bincount instead of torch.unique.
The scaling harness explicitly attests only its deterministic bounded-ring edges.

verification.gpu_gate: CUDA BF16 and FP32 smoke passed

resolution.claim_boundary: O(E_local + N) applies to the fixed-width content-validated model hot path. Neighbor construction, duplicate/self validation, data loading and task accuracy are excluded.
